affected_subject.reason: Identifies UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice and its TWAP derivation logic.

trigger_or_action.reason: Flash-loan/MEV attack pushing spot tradePrice before swap triggers the flawed check.

direct_effect.reason: Manipulated price passes slippage guard, swaps/buybacks execute at attacker-controlled rates causing value loss.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected TWAP-based slippage protection vs actual cancellation making guard ineffective.

summary: Report explains the flawed oracle function, the manipulation trigger, the resulting manipulated-price execution, and the broken slippage-protection relation, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
